The image engine is global: `core/references/image-flow.md` (flow), `core/references/world-deck/` (variety), `core/references/global-rules.md` + the gates (compliance), `core/tools/` (finishing). This brief is everything that is specific to GLP-1.

## Who it's for
Adults 30–60 managing weight who want predictable pricing and clinician guidance.

**Audience (`product.json`, the dealer's default):** men and women: the image question asks Mix of men and women (Recommended) / Men / Women / Product only; Mix alternates over the person slots.

## What it is (bible, one line)
All audiences

## Creative direction (bible)
- Label and pages must read “compounded semaglutide” / “compounded tirzepatide.”
- Show both vials (semaglutide and tirzepatide) by default. If only one vial is shown, it must be tirzepatide.
- Never show semaglutide on its own.
- Use “GLP-1” as the umbrella term in headers and titles.
- Every ad says “one price” or “no surprise price increases.”

## Headlines: references, not limits
The bible's headlines, hooks and benefits in `references/product-bible.md` are inspiration for what this product does and how the brand talks. Write bold, fresh lines in each world's own voice. **The only fence is the Hard NOs** (global section 2 + the product's, below); Jeremy signs off on wording before anything goes live. No tiers, no per-line approvals (Mitansh 2026-11-05).

## Hard stops (this product)
- Lines the screening table marks ❌ / Hard NO conflict: never. Everything that is not a Hard NO is wording, and wording is free.
- **Every ad carries the price line:** "One Price, No Surprise Increases" / "One predictable price" (as a line, a pill or the offer badge).
- **"GLP-1" in headers; "compounded semaglutide" / "compounded tirzepatide" whenever a drug is named.**
- No before/after, body comparison, body areas, scales, tape, waistlines; no melt / burn / shred; no timing promises; no
  guarantees; no disease words. "Supports / helps".
- **No needles, syringes, pens, injecting or "needle-free"** in words or pictures. One vial or both side by side (the winners), a still object.
- No "Are you/Do you…?" questions, no first person, no named competitors or drug brands, no "clinically" for the product.
- "GLP-1" big in every ad; never "by Everlife" on images. Proof exact; disclaimer verbatim (the footer handles both).

## Offer, CTAs and claims (from the bible, version 1793919328-c260; generated, never edit)
- **Offer:** "Save Up to 83%" is the product's highest discount (bible rule 09; source: Discount to feature, by product). It is the default CTA. Always "Save Up to N%", never a fixed discount, never another product's %.
- **Default CTA:** "Save Up to 83%". **All bible CTAs:** "Start Weight Support" · "Explore GLP-1" · "Save Up to 83%" · "Check Your Options" · "GLP-1 for $2.50/day" · "Ships Free From Pharmacy". The gate refuses any other CTA string.
- **Price CTA (approved alternative; the only $ amount allowed):** "GLP-1 for $2.50/day".
- **Variant maximums (reference only, never shown as a lower %):** semaglutide 83%, tirzepatide 70%.
- **Quick-hit benefits (word for word, the only benefit lines):** Supports Appetite Regulation · Helps Reduce Food Noise · Supports Healthy Weight Management · Promotes Healthy Metabolism · One Price, No Surprise Increases · Provider-Guided From Home.
- **More approved benefits:** Up to 20% Weight Loss · Helps Control Cravings · Supports Longer-Lasting Fullness · Helps Reduce Snacking Urges.
- **Product Hard NOs (bible):** Never say semaglutide or tirzepatide without “compounded.” · Plus all global Hard NOs on page 3.
- **Retired, never use (left the bible or banned):** Get Started Now · Ready to Make Progress Again? · Build Your Plan · Break the Plateau. One Clear Price. · Real Support for Your Weight-Loss Journey · Your Next Chapter Starts Lighter · Get Back in Control of Your Routine · Built for Sustainable Progress.
